messages:
cory: Hey team — after upgrading to redwood-sdk 4.0.0 my service crashes on start. Traceback:

Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "app.py", line 12, in <module>
    from redwood import Client
ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'redwood'

I installed with:

$ pip install redwood-sdk==4.0.0

python --version: 3.10.12
pip list: redwood-sdk 4.0.0, httpx 0.24.0
Any ideas?

jordan: hi Cory — can you paste `pip show redwood-sdk` and a quick `ls` of your site-packages? Also did you upgrade from 3.x or is this a fresh install?

cory: Upgraded from 3.2.1. pip show output:
Name: redwood-sdk
Version: 4.0.0
Home-page: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk
Location: /home/cory/.local/lib/python3.10/site-packages
Requires: httpx, pydantic

site-packages ls:
redwood_sdk/   redwood_sdk-4.0.0.dist-info/
(no top-level 'redwood' dir)

jordan: Ah — this explains it. 4.0.0 introduced a top-level package rename (redwood -> redwood_sdk) to avoid a PyPI name collision. We called it out in the CHANGELOG but some docs/examples were missed. Two options for you:

- Update imports: `from redwood_sdk import Client` (recommended)
- Pin to the last 3.x: `pip install "redwood-sdk<4.0.0"` if you need more time to migrate

Quick workaround if you can't change many files right away (hacky):

# app entrypoint shim
import importlib, sys
sys.modules['redwood'] = importlib.import_module('redwood_sdk')

This creates a runtime alias so `import redwood` continues to work. Not ideal long-term.

lina: @jordan thanks for the context. we'll push a docs/quickstart update to show `redwood_sdk` imports and make sure the examples are accurate. i'll also open a release ticket to add an explicit compatibility shim (tiny package that exposes the old namespace) so upgrades are less disruptive.

release-bot: Created issue #421: add top-level shim package for 4.x compatibility (assigned to lina_devex). ETA: 48 hours.

jordan: One more note — if you have automated codemods, a simple grep/sed or rope-based refactor can update imports across a repo quickly. If you want, share a small example and we can suggest a one-liner.

cory: Thanks — switching imports now. Confirmed app starts with `from redwood_sdk import Client` :thumbsup: Will hold off pinning. Appreciate the quick help!
